_comment: Vendor copy that feeds repo/helm-openclaw.html's HELMKIT marker regions. Pre-kit state: every fragment here is authored verbatim from HELM-MAINTENANCE-BUILD-SPEC §3.1 (2026-09-05), because helm/agent-kit does not exist until HELM-AGENT-KIT-1 lands. The snippet gate (scripts/gen-helm-openclaw-snippets.mjs --check) prints ADVISORY: TODO-KIT for pre-kit regions and keeps passing; when HELM-AGENT-KIT-1 lands, its PR replaces these files with the kit's emitted fragments and the gate flips from advisory to real.
vendor: hand-vendored by HELM-OPENCLAW-PAGE-1 (2026-09-08). The copy step was NOT added to .github/workflows/helm-guide-freshness-schedule.yml: the weekend rule forbids widening that report-only job (contents:read, issues:write only) into a cross-repo checkout that commits to main, and no other existing job could carry it without a new workflow file. HELM-AGENT-KIT-1's PR owns the re-vendor.
